artifact.reason: Reference singleton adapter pattern for FMU adapter. get_instance() classmethod, lazy initialization, settings injection.
Reference pydantic-settings pattern with BaseSettings, .env loading, and @lru_cache singleton.
Reference FastAPI app setup: lifespan context manager, CORS middleware, router includes, exception handler.
Reference router pattern: APIRouter with prefix/tags, response_model, HTTP methods calling controller.
Reference controller pattern: init with adapter, async methods, delegates to model, error handling.
POC FMPy usage: read_model_description for variable discovery.
POC FMPy usage: FMU2Slave instantiation, doStep execution, input/output handling.

constraints.constraint: Follow MVC pattern: routers/ (view) → controllers/ (business logic) → models/ (domain) with adapters/ for external services
Use pydantic-settings with .env files for configuration

constraint.title: Pre-validate all FMU inputs
constraint.reason: FMU accepts ANY input without throwing errors (tested: TZon=-100K, VDis_flow=-1, uOpeMod=99 all accepted)
constraint.requirement: API must validate before calling doStep(): Temperature 250-350K, Airflow >= 0, Operation mode 1-7

constraint.title: No native FMU state persistence
constraint.reason: FMU reports canGetAndSetFMUstate=False, canSerializeFMUstate=False - cannot save/restore internal state
constraint.workaround: FMU is pure function of (inputs, simulation_time). Track simulation_time in database. On restart, replay to last simulation_time with single large step.

constraints.constraint: FMPy library only (not PyFMI) - simpler installation and sufficient for needs
Singleton adapter pattern for FMU management (like BuildingMOTIFAdapter)
Python 3.11+ required, type hints mandatory, PEP 8 + Black formatting

interface.name: BuildingMOTIFAdapter.get_instance()
interface.signature: @classmethod get_instance(cls, db_path: str | None = None, settings: Settings | None = None) -> BuildingMOTIFAdapter

interface.name: FMPy FMU2Slave
interface.signature: fmu = FMU2Slave(guid, unzipDirectory, modelIdentifier, instanceName); fmu.doStep(currentCommunicationPoint, communicationStepSize)

tests.standards: TDD approach required per CLAUDE.md. Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Follow building-semantics-api-app test structure: tests/unit/ for isolated unit tests, tests/integration/ for API and adapter tests. Use conftest.py for shared fixtures. Mock external services (FMU) in unit tests. Integration tests use real FMU with tmp_path. Type hints required. Test naming: test_*.py files, test_* functions.
